system.description:
You know how to put the full weight of your momentum into attacks while riding a Mount or a Speeder Bike.

Prerequisite: Trained in Pilot or Ride

Effect: When riding a Beast as a Mount or on a Speeder Bike (as a passenger or a Pilot), you add +1 die of damage to any melee attacks if your Mount or Vehicle has already moved at least its speed this turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Threats of the Galaxy
